title: 1RB0LE_0RC0RA_1RD1RF_1LA0LD_1LD0RF_1RB---: the copy loop in Lean, 51 of the 54 copy ticks proved
text: In a copy tick the head shuttles between the left end and a block X, copying X into a new first block. Each round of this loop is the same seven local steps whatever blocks stand in front, so Lean proves the round for every list of blocks and the loop by induction on X. With the first rounds proved for each of the 21 front shapes, 51 of the 54 copy ticks of the first 10<sup>10</sup> steps are proved for every X, every chain and all block sizes, and each theorem ends at the list the run reaches. With the 198 front-rule ticks, 249 of the 258 left-end ticks now have a Lean proof.
